messages.content: I got my first big spike in followers, what should I actually do with that?

Honestly, capitalize on it fast - that's the window where a call-to-action actually converts, since attention is genuinely elevated right now. I'd push a subscribe/follow prompt harder than usual for the next few days.

Then go back to your normal rhythm, but check what specifically caused the spike so you can potentially repeat it. Not gonna lie, a lot of creators get this spike and never figure out why - that's the real missed opportunity.
